# TRS-80 Dev Environment
#
# Z80 assembly development with a cycle-true TRS-80 Model 1 in the background.
#
# ## Quick start
#
# 1. Wait for setup to finish (clones trs80-rev-z, builds Verilator emulator)
# 2. The machine auto-starts on folder open (debug link on tcp:5555)
# 3. Assemble your program: Task → "zmac: Assemble Current File"
# 4. Press F5 → select "TRS-80 (hello.asm)" or "TRS-80 (attach, no symbols)"
#
# ## Tasks
#
#   TRS-80: Start Machine   — (auto, but restart after Stop)
#   TRS-80: Stop Machine    — kill the emulator process
#   TRS-80: Screen Dump     — text-mode VRAM snapshot in terminal
#   zmac: Assemble          — build the .asm file you have open
#
# ## Disk images
#
# Drop .dmk files into /workspace/disks/ — they auto-mount as drives 0–3.
